content: एव ^1¦ {%a.%} <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 Going, moving. .²2 Speedy, quick; एवो गन्ता; ये च एवा मरुतः <ls>Uṇ. 1. 150</ls>. .{@-वः@} .²1 A course, way; or a courser, a fleet horse; स्वेभिरेवैश्चरतः <ls>Rv. 1. 62. 8</ls>; (<ab>pl.</ab>) mode of proceeding, custom, habit; or according to Sāyaṇa a desire or hymn.

एव ^2¦ {%ind.%} This particle is most frequently used to strengthen and emphasize the idea expressed by a word:-- (1) Just, quite, exactly; एवमेव quite so, just so; (2) same, very, identical; अर्थोष्मणा विरहितः पुरुषः स एव <ls>Bh. 2. 40</ls> that very man; (3) only, alone, merely, (implying exclusion); सा तथ्यमेवाभिहिता भवेन <ls>Ku. 3. 63</ls> only the truth, nothing but the truth; so नाम्नैव, स एव वीरः he alone (and not others); (4) already; गत एव न ते निवर्तते <ls>Ku. 4. 30</ls>; (5) scarcely, the moment, as soon as; chiefly with participles; उपस्थितेयं कल्याणी नाम्नि कीर्तित एव यत् <ls>R. 1. 87</ls> as soon as the name was uttered; इति चिन्तयन्नेव while just thinking <ab>&c.</ab>; (6) also, likewise; तथैव so also; (7) like, as (showing similarity); श्रीस्त एव मेस्तु <ls>G. M.</ls> (= तव इव); and (8) generally to emphasize a statement; भवितव्यमेव तेन <ls>U. 4</ls> it {%will%} (surely) take place. It is also said to imply the senses of (9) detraction; (10) diminution (11) command; (12) restraint; or (13) used merely as an expletive. (This particle is used in the Vedas in the senses of so, just so, like, indeed, truly, really) (14) Again; एवशब्दश्च पुनरित्यस्मिन्नर्थे भविष्यति . यथा क्षीरेण भुक्त्वा देवदत्तः क्षीरेणैव भुञ्जीतेति . भुञ्जीतैवेति पुनरिति गम्यते . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 10. 8. 36</ls>.

एवम् {%ind.%} .²1 Thus, so, in this manner or way; (referring to what precedes as well as to what follows); अस्त्येवम् <ls>Pt. 1</ls> it is so; एवंवादिनि देवर्षौ <ls>Ku. 6. 84</ls>; ब्रूया एवम् <ls>Me. 103</ls> (what follows); एवमस्तु be it so, amen; यद्येवम् so; किमेवम् why so; मैवम्, मा मैवम् oh, not so, (do not do so) एवम् has sometimes an adjectival force; एवं वचनम् such words. .²2 Yes, quite so (implying assent); सीता -अहो जाने तास्मिन्नेव काले वर्ते . राम- एवम् <ls>U. 1</ls>; एवं यदात्थ भगवन् <ls>Ku. 2. 31</ls>. It is also said to have the senses of. .²3 likeness. .²4 sameness of manner; .²5 affirmation or determination; .²6 command; or it is often used merely as an expletive. (In the Vedas एवम् occurs very rarely; its place being usually taken up by एव).
